content: Jesus cuti causarishcamanda
Israel samana punzha pasashcahuasha Domingo punzha ña pagariupi, ishcai (2) huarmiguna Magdalenamanda Maria chi shuc Mariandi pambashcata ricungahua rinaura.
Cungaimanda shuc angel uraicusha chi juctuta tapashca rumita anchuchisha chi jahuai tiyarira. Chasna racpi allpa sinzhita cuyurira.
Chi angelga dilampashcacuinta punzhaglla ricurira, pai churariashca llachapaga puyucuinta ruyaglla ricuric ara.
Chi juctuta cuirauc sundaluguna paita ricusha yapa manzharisha huañushcacuinta sirinaura.
Huarmigunataga chi angel nira, Ama manzhanguichichu, cruspi huanchishca Jesusta canguna mascaucta yachani.
Pai nishcacuinta ña causarishcami, caibi illanmi. Ricuc shamuichi paita churashcatas.

Ricushcahuasha uctalla ringuichi pai japishca runagunata cuintangahua pai causarishcami nisha. Paimi cangunata ñaupasha Galileama punda ringa, chibimi paitaga ricunguichi nisha cuintagrichi. Chita cuintangahuami shamurani nira chi angel.
Chi huarmiguna chita uyasha manzharishca aushallata yapa cushiyasha huairashina callpasha rinaura Jesus japishca runagunata cuintangahua.
Chasna riushcai Jesusmi paigunata tupagrisha saludara. Paiguna Jesuspagma caillayasha chaquita japisha paita alabanaura.
Chasna racpi Jesus paigunata nira, Ama manzharichichu. Ñáuca huauquishina tucuc japishca runagunata cuintagrichi Galilea partima paiguna rinauchun, chibi ñucata tupahuanaungami.
Sundaluguna cuintashcamanda
Huarmiguna riunaupi chi juctuta cuirac sundaluguna llacta ucuma risha israel pagri amugunama tucui chibi pasashcata cuintanaura.
Israel pagri amuguna chasna rimashcata uyasha israel rucu mandaccunahuan imasnata rashun nisha cuintanacungahua rinaura. Cuintashcahuasha chi sundalugunama ashca cullquita cunaura casna nisha,
Canguna casna ninguichi, tuta ñucanchi puñuushcaibimi pai japishca runaguna shamusha, paihua aichataga apashca anaura nisha pitahuas rimanguichi.
Amu Pilato chi shimitas uyasha cangunata piñacpiga ñucanchimi paihuan cuintasha alichishun.
Chasna rimacta uyasha sundaluguna cullquita japisha paigunama rimashcashinallata cuintanaura. Chi llullashca shimitaga chara cunan angamami israelguna quirinaun.
Jesus pai japishca runagunata dispirishcamanda
Chihuasha chi chunga shuc (11) pai japishca runaguna Galilea partima rinaura Jesus ñaupa rimashca urcuma.
Chibi paita ricusha alabanaura. Randi maicangunaga Jesus acta mana sirtuta quirinaurachu.
Jesus paigunahuagma caillayasha nira, Jahuapachai cai pachaibihuas tucuita mandana ushaitaga Yaya Diosmi ñucama cuhuashca.
Chasnamandami tucui runaguna ñucata quirisha catic tucunauchun nisha yachachigringuichi, paigunata Yaya Diospa shutihuan, Diospa Churi shutihuan, Diospa Samai shutihuan bautisanguichi.
Ñáuca cangunama tucui rimasha mandashcagunata ranauchun nisha yachachisha puringuichi. Sirtupachami tucui uras, hasta cai pacha tucurinagama, ñuca cangunahuan tiyashami nira.
